title: Antigravity target writes its skill to .agents/skills (ODOC-556 ruling 28b8ed5)
description: Follow-up to QCLI-543/545, ruled by opum-doc (ODOC-556 on opum-doc origin/dev, #1516, squash 28b8ed5). Ruling, verbatim: "- Skill location: an Antigravity target writes .agents/skills/<tool>/SKILL.md, the same path and file as a Codex target. A repository with both targets gets that one file. A Claude Code target keeps .claude/skills/<tool>/SKILL.md, unchanged. - Leftovers: R1 applies unchanged. A .claude/skills/<tool>/SKILL.md that only an Antigravity target accounts for reports as drift, and is never deleted in any skill-source mode, --force included. - Instruction file: GEMINI.md stays as quest writes it today. Not ruled further here. - Carrier and timing: one quest-cli follow-up, plus the lore check. It goes in the paired lore + quest release if it is ready by the cut, so that release does not ship a path that becomes a leftover. It is not a blocker for ODOC-556 criterion 1, whose checklist ticks Codex only." Today antigravity keeps the .claude path (questSkillPathForTarget returns questSkillPath for any target but codex). Consequence from that text: in repo mode a Quest block in GEMINI.md alone no longer exempts a .claude leftover; only a Claude target (a CLAUDE.md block) does, so the checklist note on QCLI-543 (step 5) changes wording. Expected files, for dispatch-floor: src/application/agents/agent-instructions.ts (questSkillPathForTarget, questSkillPathsForTargets, checkLeftoverClaudeSkill), src/cli/main.ts (the agents handler claudePathInUse loop and orphan handling, writeInitInstructions, the --force help), src/application/command-help.ts and src/application/agents/guides.ts (skill-path prose), src/ports/workspaces.ts (comment), CHANGELOG.md, test/qcli543-codex-skill-path.test.ts, test/contract/bootstrap-process.test.ts, and .quest/ records. No workflow, dependency, pin or release-path file. Cross-repo: opum-cli-e2e rows that init with an antigravity target, if any, and lore-cli's own Antigravity check; report, do not edit.

acceptanceCriteria.text: An antigravity target writes .agents/skills/quest/SKILL.md and nothing under .claude/skills for the skill; a repository with both codex and antigravity targets gets that one file
A claude target still writes .claude/skills/quest/SKILL.md, unchanged, and a repository with claude and antigravity targets gets both files

A .claude/skills/quest/SKILL.md that only an antigravity target accounts for reports as drift under agents --check, exit 6 naming the path, and is never deleted in any skill-source mode, --force included

In repo mode a Quest block in GEMINI.md alone no longer exempts the .claude leftover; only a Claude target (a CLAUDE.md block) does, and the operator-checklist note on QCLI-543 carries the changed wording
GEMINI.md is written exactly as today
Each behaviour above has a test, with mutation predictions written before the run

implementationNotes: Implemented 2026-10-31 on fix/QCLI-548-antigravity-agents-skill. questSkillPathForTarget now returns .claude only for claude; codex and antigravity share .agents/skills/quest/SKILL.md (one file when both). checkLeftoverClaudeSkill applies to any non-claude target, the in-use exemption is a CLAUDE.md block only (GEMINI.md no longer exempts), repo-mode message names "Antigravity" for that target, plugin/none message says "an antigravity target reads its skill from ... and this workspace generates none ... --force included". GEMINI.md written as before. Help, the agents guide and CHANGELOG updated; the checklist note on QCLI-543 updated (step 3 Antigravity line, step 5 exemption). Tests (test/qcli543-codex-skill-path.test.ts, 25): Antigravity-only exact file set, codex+antigravity one file, claude+antigravity both, repo-mode drift and --force survival, CLAUDE.md exemption, plugin and none. Mutation M7, prediction file written BEFORE the run (with an arithmetic erratum recorded, also before the run: 25 tests not 26, 7 named red not 8): restoring the old .claude path for Antigravity went red on exactly the 7 named tests, 18 green. bun run test: 1364 pass, 1 fail (QCLI-411 by design). Cross-repo, report-only: opum-cli-e2e rows that init with an antigravity target, if any (none found by the invocation sweep earlier: 10-contract-quest.mjs:384 and 40-cross-product.mjs:954 use the default target), and lore changes nothing in 0.14.2 per opum-doc.
